scenes.script: The starting state preserves the stable definition: A tiny labeled expression graph with a proposed partition, an exact witness path, a rejection/fallback path, and a promotion gate; it is never presented as a measured trace. After the change, the composition makes C9 static analytic routing inspectable: The C9 tree chooses an exact arm, then its held-out cost token lands below the profitability gate.
